newsitem.title: UK: Britain counts first for 40 pct of blacks - poll.
newsitem.headline: Britain counts first for 40 pct of blacks - poll.

text.p: Forty percent of blacks living in Britain think of themselves as British first and African or Afro-Caribbean second, a poll commissioned for a new minority newspaper found on Sunday.
Just over half of those polled -- 52 percent -- think race relations are improving, the NOP poll for the New Nation found.
But 40 percent of the 18 to 35 year olds surveyed felt race relations had deteriorated over five years.
The New Nation weekly tabloid is the brainchild of Elkin Pianim, a Ghananian by birth, and a son-in-law of the media tycoon Rupert Murdoch.
The paper will provide news about black Britain and carry sections on sport, arts, fashion, beauty and women's issues.
